story: "Through a journey that began with two friends, who transformed their shared passion for the future of digital and creative services into a creative business undertaking, TROKIT has established itself over the years as one of the leading Creative Agency in the European market. TROKIT’s expertise in branding, digital, and other creative services spans a period of over two decades. As a result of the combined efforts and hard work of its original co-founders, TROKIT has expanded considerably and consists today of three owners and a creative team dotted strategically in the European heart of Switzerland, and Southeastern Europe. The success of TROKIT is rooted in the all-encompassing outlook we have towards the projects trusted to us, and the degree of personal commitment involved."
_story: field_5e81e9bab4ff7
values: "Regardless of whether we build brands from the bottom up, or alternatively, refurbish existing brand or cater to new digital transformation, the entire creative and digital team of TROKIT comes together in a collaborative process, offering as such a multi-dimensional perspective to the projects at hand. Alongside an in-depth analysis and understanding of the strategic positioning of the brand, as well as its targeted audience and reach in the digital world, this process depends upon the deep personal involvement of the team and the amicable relationship of TROKIT with its clients."

## Privacy policy

---
title: "Privacy Policy"
date: "2020-06-18"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_lock: "1751983493:3"
_wp_page_template: impressum.php
_edit_last: "3"
impressum: 
_impressum: field_5eeb318343885
text: "<h1>Privacy Policy</h1>
&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Our Commitment to Privacy</h2>
&nbsp;

Your privacy is as important to us as it is to you. We know you hate SPAM and so do we. That is why we will never sell or share your information with anyone without your express permission. We respect your rights and will do everything in our power to protect your personal information. In the interest of full disclosure, we provide this notice explaining our online information collection practices. This privacy notice discloses the privacy practices for <a title=\"Trokit\" href=\"https://trokit.com/\">Trokit Agency Creative</a> (herein known as we, us and our company) and applies solely to information collected by this web site.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Information Collection, Use, and Sharing</h2>
&nbsp;

We are the sole owners of the information collected on this site. We only have access to information that you voluntarily give us via email or other direct contact from you. We will not sell or rent this information to anyone. We will use your information to respond to you, regarding the reason you contacted us. We will not share your information with any third party outside of our organization, other than as necessary to fulfill your request, e.g. to ship an order.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Disclosure</h2>
&nbsp;

This site uses Google web analytics service. Google may record mouse clicks, mouse movements, scrolling activity as well as text you type in this website. This site does not use Google to collect any personally identifiable information entered in this website. Google does track your browsing habits across web sites which do not use Google services.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Security</h2>
&nbsp;

We take precautions to protect your information. When you submit sensitive information via the website, your information is protected both online and offline.

Wherever we collect sensitive information (such as credit card data), that information is encrypted and transmitted to us in a secure way. You can verify this by looking for a closed lock icon at the bottom of your web browser, or looking for “https” at the beginning of the address of the web page.

While we use encryption to protect sensitive information transmitted online, we also protect your information offline. Only employees who need the information to perform a specific job (for example, billing or customer service) are granted access to personally identifiable information. The computers/servers in which we store personally identifiable information are kept in a secure environment.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Contact Form</h2>
&nbsp;

In order for us to contact you, a user must first complete the contact form. When completing the form, a user is required to give certain information (such as name and email address). This information is used to contact you about the products/services on our site in which you have expressed interest. At your option, you may also provide demographic information (such as gender or age) about yourself, but it is not required.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Links</h2>
&nbsp;

This web site contains links to other sites. Please be aware that we are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of such other sites. We encourage our users to be aware when they leave our site and to read the privacy statements of any other site that collects personally identifiable information.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h2>Email Policy</h2>
&nbsp;

Trokit Agency Creative has a strict no-spam policy.

Trokit Agency Creative will never sell or trade your email address to a third party.

Trokit Agency Creative does not send unsolicited commercial email messages. Trokit Agency Creative does send commercial email to those who have a pre-existing business relationship with us. A pre-existing business relationship means that the email recipient has made a purchase, requested information, responded to a survey or questionnaire, or had offline contact with The Lorem Ipsum Company. Email recipients may contact us at any time to opt-out of future mailings.

Trokit Agency Creative does not engage in deceptive email practices such as misleading subject lines or falsifying email addresses.

Trokit Agency Creative does not encourage deceptive practices in email marketing to its clients.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;
<h1>Terms of Service</h1>
&nbsp;

Trokit Agency Creative is a Kosovo-based company that operates and maintains a website at the URL <a href=\"https://trokit.com/\">https://trokit.com/</a>” (the “Website”) and provides certain Content Marketing, Digital Market, Social Media Marketing and SEO services described in more detail on our website. ## Creativity in quarantine at the time of the pandemic

---
title: "Creativity in quarantine at the time of the pandemic"
date: "2020-03-30"
author: "Ferdi Kamberi"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1596105769:3"
post-content: "Human life has a great value that can be reflected in the example of a ship sailing in the ocean and always challenged by the waves of the sea until I reach the right destination. We are witness that the coronavirus pandemic as known as COVID-19 has swept across the globe posing a potential danger to modern society, which is trying in every way to create safeguards, one of which is quarantine or, in sociological language, social isolation. Human being is by nature a social being who interacts with other social groups and as an individual without social groups could not survive. He has numerous of needs, including the needs which has speak the famous psychologist Maslow: “physiological needs, security needs, love and belonging, esteem /self- esteem and self-actualization needs” (Kamberi, 2019), which distinguish him as a social and cooperative being. Whereas, social isolation means staying indoors or in a space for a certain amount of time, in order to avoid contact with other people. It differs from loneliness because loneliness is a concept related to the temporary lack of social contact between an individual and other people. Social isolation can come from many different factors including: the emergence of pandemics, various conflicts, social insecurity, anxiety, depression, etc. At this time, when people are isolated, they have different needs to spend more time with their families. One of the important elements during this time that can be exploited is the creativity that “is the ability to generate, create, or discover new ideas, solutions, and possibilities. Very creative people often have intense knowledge about something, work on it for years, look at novel solutions, seek out the advice and help of other experts, and take risks. Although creativity is often associated with the arts, it is actually a vital form of intelligence that drives people in many disciplines to discover something new. Creativity can be found in every area of life, from the way you decorate your residence to a new way of understanding how a cell works” (Lumen: Introduction to Psychology). This means that people need to create social environments in order to change negative into the positive side, which will reflect also on their self-esteem, in mobility with social networking with others, especially with family and greater social security.

<img class=\"alignnone size-full wp-image-405\" src=\"http://195.69.167.59/trokit/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/oculus-for-business.jpg\" alt=\"\" />
<h1><strong>Creativity is a gift</strong></h1>
The issue of creativity is an issue that is related to the human genetic code, because everyone has the ability to create something, and this is often seen by religious people as a &amp;quot;gift from God”. So sociologists explain the society as consisting of a social structure characterized by consensus, trust, virtue and social capital. These are also the elements that are related to creativity, because they are based on healthy ideas, which today, in the age of pandemic, are desperately needed. Famous sociologist Talcott Parsons attempted to develop and perfect a general analytic model suitable for analyzing all types of collectivities. His model is AGIL, which represents the four basic functions that all social systems must perform if they are to persist. It was one of the first open systems theories of organizations: a) Adaptation: the problem of acquiring sufficient resources, b) Goal Attainment: the problem of settling and implementing goals, c) Integration: the problem of maintain solidarity or coordination among the subunits of the system, and) Latency: the problem of creating, preserving, and transmitting the system&amp;#39;s distinctive culture and values”
(see: http://faculty.babson.edu/krollag/org_site/encyclop/parsons.html). His model focuses on sustainability and function of societies, which have survived even in the most difficult times and will undoubtedly survive this difficulty.
<h1><img class=\"alignnone wp-image-1965 size-full\" src=\"http://195.69.167.59/trokit/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/Brain-and-Creaitvity-.jpg\" alt=\"\" width=\"1298\" height=\"899\" /></h1>
<h1>Creativity as a model for social desolation</h1>
Creativity is a defense mechanism in times of social isolation, it can play an important role in convincing oneself of during the time social isolation, and because intrapersonal communication influences us to convince ourselves that this social isolation is temporary. Therefore, some of the suggestions for home creativity at this time may be:
<ul>
 	<li><strong>Encouraging creativity of the immune system</strong>– in times of social isolation and lack of social contact, people are often depressed, and encouraging creativity in this period is a necessary because it first creates self-esteem and secondly it affects in human metabolism. This creativity can be accomplished through the avoidance of negative media news, increased attention to exercise, listening to music, communication, reading books, greater family attention, healthy food and vitamins;</li>
 	<li><strong>Changing the daily routine –</strong> it is important for human to change the daily routines they are used to and this should start from the hours of sleeping, food, creativity, exercises, marketplaces, and so on. In this view, the changing of the routine also avoids the problems of the psychological nature and burdens that we have in our consciousness. Just to remember the challenges of Robinson Crusoe, he was alone on the island for 28 years and finally he succeeding;</li>
 	<li><strong>Strengthening of social connections –</strong> people are blocked and often they display stages of conflict. At this time we should avoid social conflicts and strengthen social cohesion within families, then must communicating with others through social networks, telephone or other applications. While doctors call for avoiding physical distances, communicating through social distances by the apps is welcome. Therefore, we should focus more on the development of social connections, because human being sometimes knows the greatest value to the family when it does not seen to a period longer than usual;</li>
 	<li><strong>Need for Meditation -</strong> Meditation is usually a practice where the individual uses techniques to focus the mind on a particular object or activity. According to Dalai Lama, Meditation may be used with the aim of reducing stress, anxiety, depression, and pain, and increasing peace, perception. Therefore, meditation is what we need in this period in order to soothe (calm) ourselves and to influence others (family) by keeping in mind the motto &amp;quot;Careful yes, panic no&amp;quot</li>
</ul>
At the end of this essay, citizens should be patient, convey positive messages to one another, and have greater social solidarity, communicate through various applications, avoid physical contacts, and abide by the guidelines of their respective institutions. Physical and mental health are very important in this period, so everyone should pay great attention to them and strengthen family connection."
_post-content: field_5e821adf83600
_author: field_5e820d0baf60b
author-image: "2251"
_author-image: field_5e820d1aaf60c
_thumbnail_id: "1941"
post-intro: "Creativity is a defense mechanism in times of social isolation, it can play an important role in convincing oneself of during the time social isolation, and because of intrapersonal communication influences us to convince ourselves that this social isolation is temporary."
_post-intro: field_5e821dd41039e
_yoast_wpseo_content_score: "30"
_wp_old_slug: "nullam-semper-quam-sapien-vel-laoreet"
---

This brand identity represents the evolution e Copper Net and their main product/service, which is copper cabling. In line with the strategic positioning, and designed to support their presence in Swiss market, the visual identity had to be simple, to give a clear message, and to be identified from their competitors.

Logo is made of dots, inspired on the cross-section of copper wires grouped into a common jacket, whereas inside the clutch, with some darker nuances it’s shown the letter C, which represents copper cables."

To embody the essence of speed and movement, we crafted a distinct monogram featuring the letter S intersected by two dynamic slashes, framed by a powerful triangle shield. This design element not only symbolizes forward motion but also serves as a recognizable emblem for the brand.


"

By combining bold design elements with strategic branding techniques, SSprint has emerged as Kosovo's premier destination for high-quality sportswear and underwear. ## Augentic

---
title: Augentic
date: "2020-06-02"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1657024062:4"
_thumbnail_id: "1819"
work_title: "Naming, branding and website for technology driven company AUGENTIC"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "New players in the game and Technology-driven AUGENTIC, seek to provide Identity, currency and biometric solutions with reliability and safety at its core. A new decade will have unforeseen breaches in our personal information, therefore, AUGENTIC will solidify the safety of one’s identity through their trustworthy technology services."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "AUGENTIC team members are noted innovators of many technologies and services in the industries of secure identity, biometrics applications, digital payment and currency. Thanks to the professionals, scientists and tech lovers at AUGENTIC, we provide a step forward in reshaping the digital future.

The name was developed by combining two keywords that represent the core concept of the business we have fused AUTHENTIC with GENERIC. The finding was AUGENTIC.

AUGENTIC required a distinctive brand that established the business as a serious yet dependable technology partner for its clients. The brand identity had to display the centre of what connected humans and technology together in a way that has never been done before. With years of experience, Trokit was no stranger to providing clients in the technology field a comprehensive brand identity. This made the collaboration between Trokit Agency and AUGENTIC a unique experience for both parties.

Trokit identified 4 components that inspired brand identity. The iris of the eye encompasses the human vision, the roundness of the human iris providing symmetric for the logo as well as conceptualising the millions of identities that the business is dealing with. The individual symbols are fractal and display humanity as individuals, thus connecting with the biometrics.

The typography needed to be just as symbolic as the logo itself, Trokit team worked with the shapes of the symbols to generate a font that is only unique to AUGENTIC, this makes it incredibly special to this very business and sets up AUGENTIC as a distinctive brand in the Technology field.

With the logo set in stone, AUGENTIC required a website that delivered the same promise as their brand identity. The web development team at Trokit managed to concentrate the colour palate and the symbolic elements in a web design that provided AUGENTIC with an online presence whilst simultaneously delivering information important to AUGENTICS potential clients."
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1
client_location: Germany
_client_location: field_5e7b34e0212fc
project_content_2_image: "1819"
_project_content_2_image: field_5e7ca84398b0c
project_content_2_image_size: half

## Benelux

---
title: Benelux
date: "2020-03-29"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1598384726:3"
_thumbnail_id: "1990"
work_title: "Naming and branding a new boutique hotel in the region "
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">With vast competition in the hotel and hospitality industry in the Balkan region, BENELUX desired a distinct and cultured oriented visual identity. Benelux sits in the soul of Peja (Kosovo), with a beautiful location and seasonal weather to accommodate the location. This indicated that this hotel was going to be special only with the correct design infrastructure set in place.</span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The name BENELUX, is a politico-economic union and formal international intergovernmental cooperation of three neighbouring states in western Europe: Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg.    </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The team had a complex identity to unfold, 3 nations meant that the designer had to develop a logo that had coherence with that number. The research was carried out by TROKIT and with the name ‘BENELUX’ selected, the team set out to build on the country of origin from each of the 3 BENELUX nations. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The foundation was a Windmill, through being of the many features that are seen in the fertile lands of the Netherlands, the Windmill sets the style and spirit that the BENELUX states represent. Where in most of the lands in which Windmills are situated Tulips can be found, the flourishing shape of the Tulip allowed the designers to extract this shape and fused them into the Windmill representation and with 3 nations in mind, it was only fitting to have three Tulip symbols that combine to create the logo.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">As for the colours of the symbol, TROKIT decided to adapt the colours of the flags of each of the states but with some minor alterations and improvements. They did this through different tones and shades to maintain simplicity and convenience to the human eye.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">What followed was an exhibition of prints and mockups for the boutique hotel, using the tulip symbol and creating an entire gallery of material that satisfied not only BENELUX but their future customers. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">They were well and truly set for the future.</span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

## Casbas pizza

---
title: "CASBA'S Pizza"
date: "2022-04-14"
author: "trokit-editor"
_edit_lock: "1716201276:3"
_edit_last: "4"
_thumbnail_id: "2870"
_aioseop_keywords:

onesignal_notification_custom_heading: 
onesignal_notification_custom_content: 
work_title: "Naming and brand identity for oven-baked pizza business in Leicester, UK"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "<p dir=\"ltr\">The Brits love for dining has been a staple in the culture, the diverse range of food from all over the planet has been in one way or another altered by the British consumer food industry. Pizza without an exception has its special slice in the UK. The love for Italian cuisine has made pizza one of the most adored foods in Britain. With heavy competition in the market and with some of the most loved and trusted brands in the UK, Trokit had a goal of making Casba’s a memorable and modern brand.</p>

<div></div>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<p dir=\"ltr\">Sitting in the heart of the Leicester suburbs, Trokit’s mission was to develop an identity that the family business could be proud of representing in the local area, as well as translate their brand into digital and compete in the online landscape.</p>
<p dir=\"ltr\">Trokit embarked on the idea that we had to manifest the modern feel of pizza in the 21st century, but capture the historical aspects of pizza baking. With this objective in mind, the team at Trokit fused the brick oven elements and Kasbah. Kasbah is an old word used to describe ancient civilisation pedestrian cities, some of which are still around such as the ones in North Africa, and in the oriental world. This made for a fitting name for the company, however, TROKIT altered the ‘K’ to a ‘C’ to fit the westernised pronunciation of the word.</p>
<p dir=\"ltr\">The brick oven is and will always be a prefered Italian method in pizza baking. The truly authentic way of baking Pizza is usually renowned to provide the best-tasting Pizza and the brick oven provides a crusty base for the pizza which is considered one of the most important factors to judge whether a pizza.</p>
<span id=\"m_7272556085268216612gmail-docs-internal-guid-54a14094-7fff-b312-c5f4-65b09260ab36\">
With this, a logo and brand identity started to emerge. The arch of the top half of the brick oven is dubbed with the arch of the Kasbah architecture, designed into a symbol that also resonated with pizza slices as well as resembling the two main concepts. Then, TROKIT saw that the recipe was there to begin the package design that connected the logo using the chosen colours, red, brown, green and black. The brick background texture supplied the designers at TROKIT the pathway to develop packaging that would look visually engaging for Casba’s customers. </span>
<div></div>"

## Dua com

---
title: Dua.com
date: "2020-04-17"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1631175231:3"
work_title: "Branding the largest social media platform for the Albanian market."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "Exciting new social platform Dua.com was launched with the aim to connect Albanian people worldwide. The founders of Dua.com seek to establish this through a super-advanced application and overall social ecosystem established on three pillars: Dua Love, Dua Biz and Dua Help."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "Through these services, Dua.com provides the Albanians a unique opportunity to connect world-wide and in all areas of their social lives, whether that means making new friends, engaging in a serious relationship or expanding their professional network.

This project involved a close cooperation between the Dua team lead by its CEO Mr. Valon Asani. And Trokit Agency Creative. As Mr. Asani noted, no better agency than Trokit can embark on the kind of creative ambition to develop a brand identity that contributes in connecting 12 million Albanians worldwide. Prepared for the challenge, Trokit’s objective was to craft a digital Albanian identity with the traditional Albanian symbol of the two-headed eagle, which was transformed into a contemporary logo that befits today’s modern and digital world.

By means of in-depth research into other emblems of Albanian tradition and culture, and through close interaction with the Dua.com team, additional features were integrated in the brand identity. Besides the two-headed eagle that historically represents the Albanians’ sense of unity despite their geographical distance, the symbol of Besa is another identifying component of Albanian culture, and a feature they take particular pride in. Meaning ‘Honor’ in English, Besa represents an unwavering kind of loyalty, spoken only when pledging truthfulness in words and actions.

The symbol of the heart, which universally represents love was tied into this cultural concept. Indeed, Dua means love in Albanian and together with Besa it entails a promise both spoken and performed by the placement of one’s hand on the heart. Tied together, these symbols formed the anchor upon which Trokit crafted the identity of the unique Albanian platform Dua.com. Along with the traditional black and red colors, and peculiar typography, the outcome is a brand identity that resonates with both the past and present, and brings the Albanians together in the digital world of the future."

## Fixposition

---
title: Fixposition
date: "2020-05-13"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1595584536:3"
work_title: "Brand identity development for Swiss navigation system company."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Drone technology has allowed for the trajectory of new innovators, next-gen scientists and businesses to utilise the tech for their advantage. Swiss FIX POSITION joins that list of companies employing drone technology. Specialising in navigation, they are set to provide their clients with a product to rely on, they care greatly on improving navigation solutions for vehicles. </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKT were employed to develop an identity that depicted their offering. Knowing drones is the sole element of their business, TROKIT wanted to work around this. A birds-eye view of the drone began to emerge, forming the ‘X’ of FIXPOSITION. A generic ‘X’ symbol was not what the team thought was adequate so, one more alteration was made, the symbol then was a split in the middle. The split resembled two arrows pointing opposite directions, this was to draw a viewer's attention to the middle as well as describe the free movement of the drones. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">With segments combined, typography was then established. A clean, modern and future-like font was employed by the designers. Providing FIX POSITION with an extensive identity to move forward into the future. </span>"

## Galeria shopping mall

---
title: "Galeria Shopping Mall"
date: "2020-05-06"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1631188536:3"
_thumbnail_id: "1157"
work_title: "Brand Identity for one of the biggest shopping mall in region."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The international retail industry has been gaining momentum in Kosovo, more well-known brands are now entering the market in the region due to more opportunities being developed by big investors. GALERIA is an example of this momentum, TROKIT were to lay cards on the table for the organisation and provide a brand identity.  </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKIT was inspired to deliver a trademark for GALERIA, one that was endearing and identifiable. Through this thinking, the team had developed a sans serif typography that was bubbly and bold, allowing for a clean solid colour to be implemented. Magenta.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Magenta is one of universal harmony and emotional balance. In the meaning of colours, magenta represents universal love at its highest level. It promotes compassion, kindness and cooperation and encourages a sense of self-respect and contentment in those who use it.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">An emotional drive for the target audience is the symbol, TROKIT knows this, so they evolved part of the ‘G’ from the typography and established a simple and versatile symbol. The versatility was key, as for a shopping mall it can be used in various formats for different purposes on the centre. Also, the symbol allowed for an array of textures and patterns to be implemented to represent the options of activities and stores in the GALERIA shopping centre.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">With all elements combined TROKIT fundamentally allowed GALERIA to exist in the modern era in regards to a visual brand identity. </span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

## Gentli

---
title: Gentli
date: "2020-05-05"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "1"
_edit_lock: "1594994502:1"
work_title: "Engineering an e-commerce web for a pioneer in balkan shoe retail sector."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Gentli Shoes is one of the nation's leading shoe retailers with more than 20 stores in Kosovo and Albania. Since opening its first store more than 30 years ago, Gentli has become a synonym of good quality shoes. Gentli shoppers can find a surprising selection of high-quality, on-trend, brand name and designer merchandise for women, men, and children. Gently has exclusivity for Kosovo, Albania and Northern Macedonia for well-known shoe brands: Ciciban, Clarks, Vagabond, Steve Madden, Fly London, Ara, Imac, Vizzano, Beira Rio, Moleca etc.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Based on their offering it urged their management to make another step forward by building an e-shop platform, which will bring them closer to their customers and confirm their leading position in this sector.</span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The collaboration with Gentli shoes is long overdue, therefore the Trokit team had a clear idea about their request.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Trokit designed a platform to help Gentli adapt quickly to changing customer demands. This gives the company a storefront that delivers exactly what customers want — an online experience (service) for a short time online purchasing, that works on their mobile device or laptop in a short timeframe.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">“We think that launching a streamlined eCommerce portal helped us to win new customers and better serve existing ones. It’s a huge asset to expand our business in the future”, said owner Genc Domi after the launch of Gentli Shoes e-commerce platform.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The goal was to build a platform to help customers to manage their accounts online with easy re-ordering, order history and order management.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The user interface designed by the Trokit engineers was created so it suits the context of usage, cognitive processes and emotions of customers.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">This process involved:</span>
<ul>
 	<li><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Information architecture (IA) and navigation structuring</span></li>
 	<li><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Customization of the right template according to requirements</span></li>
 	<li><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Creation of layouts, fonts, displays and other graphic elements corresponding with brand visual identification</span></li>
 	<li><span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Mobile commerce usability testing (RWD)</span></li>
</ul>
<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The back end uses the latest technology, as a result, it enables the website to be fast, efficient and easy to manage its resources.</span>"

## Ick

---
title: ICK
date: "2020-04-15"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1631174149:3"
work_title: "Rebranding of ICK, the leading innovative centre in Kosovo and the region. "
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Innovation Centre Kosovo (ICK) is a centre whose aim is to connect the research and development component of the scientific field with the business sector. ICK was founded to support entrepreneurship, innovation and commercially based business development, with a focus on information and communication technology. The centre supports both start-ups and existing companies with the potential for growth.</span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">On the eve of it’s the sixth anniversary its founders wanted to renew the centre’s image. They challenged the creative agency to make the centre’s identity simple, but something iconic which will be recognizable from miles away. After a thorough analysis and brainstorming with the client, we recognized the utter diversity of the activities and people of ICK. We knew that the new ICK brand identity has to be boundless and playful.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The Innovation Centre Kosovo initials, Trokit designed with three basic geometrical figures: rectangle, circle and triangle, as well as three solid colours: blue, green and red. Combination of these figures and colours produces infinite shapes and nuances, which is the very philosophy of the innovative centre. The organization is not typical, it is rather original and inventive, creating in people’s mind an expectation for ICK to be bold. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The clear intention of the new brand is to present ICK’s ability to think out of the box and be out of the ordinary, all the while looking modern and maintaining the serious element of the organization.</span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

## Iris

---
title: IRIS
date: "2020-05-15"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1595936393:3"
work_title: "Transforming and rebranding a 50-year-old company is a big responsibility."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Oztrakia is one of the well-known trading companies in Turkey, founded by Mustafa Iris in 1973 in Edirne. Since the company's success started to expand in the region they operated in different countries with different names based on the same business concept.   </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Despite the company's success over time, there was also confusion with the audience, this is because it operated under different names and visual identities in different countries. The time for restructuring was indispensable.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKIT worked closely with the management team to set a new vision. Thus, after many meetings and brainstorming sessions, we came to the conclusion that we need a master brand, under the umbrella which will represent all the companies with the same visual identity. The team came up with a master brand with a new name IRIS group, because it's a familiar business we named this company with the surname of its founder.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKIT decided to hold the colour blue from the past and installed the yellow colour to make it warmer to provide a positive feeling to the brand.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">All this process resulted in the one and unique identity anywhere the company operates. This transformation helped the business to have greater scope for growth and build trust and confidence to the brand, customers and partners.</span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The end product delivered, in a way that connected what the brand’s values are and its position in the local community. JOY was now in full motion to start employing their identity not only in the local community but now with an online presence. </span>"

_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "Nestled in the picturesque lake town of Montreux, Switzerland, Kaïa Aesthetic Treatment Clinic stands as a beacon of elegance and sophistication. Founded with a commitment to enhancing and refreshing the natural beauty of women, Kaïa aims to become a synonym with ageless aesthetics that prioritizes authenticity over fleeting trends.

Kaïa is a name that resonates with grace and beauty and encapsulates the essence of the clinic's mission. The brand's identity revolves around the celebration of female natural beauty, steering clear of artificial-looking results and trends that fade with time. Positioned as a sanctuary for timeless aesthetics, Kaïa strives to provide treatments that empower women to embrace their unique features and enhance them in a subtle and elegant manner.

The typography plays a crucial role in conveying the clinic's commitment to elegance and sophistication. Kaïa has opted for an elegant curvy font, a deliberate choice that mirrors the graceful curves found in the female form. This choice not only reinforces the brand's commitment to femininity but also communicates a sense of softness and approachability, making clients feel welcomed and at ease."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "At the heart of Kaïa's visual identity lies a symbol inspired by a segment of the letter 'K.' This symbol intricately represents the perfection of the female face and body. By incorporating this element into the brand, Kaïa reinforces its dedication to precision and the artistry involved in enhancing natural beauty. The symbol acts as a visual anchor, a reminder of the clinic's core values and its commitment to achieving aesthetic perfection with every treatment.

The colour palette reflects the clinic's aspiration to create a serene and luxurious atmosphere. The blueish blue displays calmness and tranquility, promoting a sense of relaxation for clients seeking rejuvenation. Complementing this calming hue is the goldy sand, a warm and sophisticated colour that adds a touch of opulence to the brand. Furthermore, these colours create a harmonious balance, reinforcing the clinic's commitment to beauty and a serene experience.

The brand not only enhances the natural beauty of its clients but also invites them into a world where authenticity and elegance reign supreme, establishing an experience that celebrates the inherent beauty of every woman.

_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "KB Prishtina has won 13 official league titles, 13 Kosovo Cup and two Balkan League titles. In the last two editions, KB Prishtina has successfully represented Kosovo at the FIBA Europe Cup, making them the most popular and decorated basketball club in Kosovo. Since the clubs were established, they didn’t have a defined brand identity system. Therefore, the most important thing for TROKIT was finalising the process of branding the club."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">First steps were with the badge. Three different fonts in the previous badge were replaced with only one powerful font. A font that will represent in a remarkable way the unrivalled champions of Kosovo. TROKIT decided to change the grey frame of the shield with blue colour and white typography on it. The team added gold and silver stars above the shield in order to show the prestige of the club.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The second phase was designing the jersey for the team. The club was interested to come on with something unique. Trokit kept traditional blue stripes in white jersey, but interceded on them with thin to border lines, standing for activity and progress. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Whilst TROKIT are not fashion designers, they had delivered and scored a three-pointer. </span>"

## Kuchen rausch

---
title: KuchenRausch
date: "2024-02-29"
author: "trokit-editor"
_edit_lock: "1716202609:3"
_edit_last: "3"
onesignal_meta_box_present: "1"
onesignal_send_notification: 
onesignal_modify_title_and_content: 
onesignal_notification_custom_heading: 
onesignal_notification_custom_content: 
work_title: "Rebranding and Web Development for Kuchenrausch, Berlin's Iconic Bakery"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "In the heart of Berlin, lies Kuchenrausch, a quaint bakery and pastry shop that has been delighting locals for over 15 years. Translating to \"Cake Frenzy\" in English, the name itself embodies the indulgent experience of getting lost in the sweetness of life. Now, with a nod to the past and a vision for the future, Kuchenrausch is undergoing an exciting transformation, blending its time-honored charm with modern flair through rebranding and web development.

Maintaining its roots while embracing evolution, Kuchenrausch's rebranding journey was meticulous yet spirited. One element that remained unchanged was the crown, symbolizing the bakery's enduring legacy and dedication to excellence. Positioned atop the head of the bear, an iconic emblem of Berlin, the crown's inclusion is infused with local pride. This addition not only pays homage to the bakery's cherished hometown but also infuses its identity with renewed symbolism.

Key to the new brand is the integration of the bear with a unique twist. Nestled within the bear's visage lies a concentric circle, a whimsical representation of the intoxicating effect of cakes and pastries. This clever fusion captures the essence of Kuchenrausch—where indulgence meets sophistication, and every bite is a journey to euphoria."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "A carefully curated palette enhances the brand's vibrancy. Shades of brown serve as the primary color, embodying the comforting nature of the bear, while hues of yellow evoke the freshness of bread and baked goods. Complementing these tones is the inviting caramel, reminiscent of the luscious sweetness found within Kuchenrausch’s cakes.

With scrupulous attention to detail, Trokit developed a cohesive brand language, from iconography to color schemes, that seamlessly translates Kuchenrausch's essence into every touchpoint.

Central to this transformation process is the vibrant webpage, a digital gateway to Kuchenrausch's delectable offerings. Beyond mere aesthetics, the website serves as a dynamic platform, inviting customers to explore a tantalizing array of cakes and pastries. Seamlessly integrated within the site is an e-shop, where cake passionates can indulge their cravings with just a few clicks, bringing the bakery's delights directly to their doorstep.

In rebranding Kuchenrausch, the aim was not merely to refresh its image but to reignite the passion for artisanal baking that has defined it for over a decade. Through thoughtful design and strategic storytelling, the bakery emerges rejuvenated, poised to captivate both loyal patrons and newcomers alike.

As Kuchenrausch embraces its new identity, it remains steadfast in its commitment to excellence, inviting all to embark on a journey of indulgence, one delicious treat at a time. With its reimagined brand and vibrant online presence, the bakery stands as a testament to the enduring power of tradition, innovation, and, of course, the intoxicating allure of cakes."

work_title: "Branding and Website Development for Kulm, a pleasant novelty in the busy Swiss real estate market"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "In the dynamic of the real estate market of Switzerland, Kulm emerges as a beacon of innovation and sustainability. With a steadfast commitment to fostering a built environment that harmonizes with both people and the planet, Kulm stands poised to redefine the standards of modern development.

Kulm is not just a real estate company but a visionary force driving the transformation towards a sustainable and resilient future. At the core of Kulm's ethos lie three pillars of sustainability: Social, Economic, and Ecological. By intertwining these pillars, Kulm strives to create spaces that enrich lives, empower communities, and protect the environment.

Drawing inspiration from the intricate beauty of a bird's nest, Kulm's visual identity embodies the essence of sustainability and innovation. The logo subtly incorporates the letter K within the nest, symbolizing Kulm's integral role in shaping the environment of sustainable development. Delicate lines, reminiscent of thin wood branches, further emphasize Kulm's commitment to natural harmony and organic integration."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "Reflecting the lush greenery of Switzerland's landscapes, Kulm's primary color is a vibrant shade of green, representing growth, vitality, and renewal. Complemented by a pale nuance of olive, the color palette evokes a sense of tranquillity and balance, mirroring Kulm's dedication to ecological preservation and holistic well-being.

To realize Kulm's vision of sustainable development, Trokit was enlisted to develop a comprehensive visual identity, iconography, and dynamic webpage. Leveraging their expertise in design and digital innovation, Trokit crafted a compelling narrative that resonates with Kulm's mission and values.

Trokit seamlessly integrated Kulm's brand identity into every aspect of its digital presence, creating an immersive and engaging experience for visitors. From the sleek logo design to the intuitive user interface, every element reflects Kulm's unwavering commitment to sustainability and excellence.

In conclusion, Kulm emerges as a trailblazer in the realm of sustainable real estate development, driven by a passion for innovation and a dedication to environmental stewardship."

## Lika

---
title: LIKA
date: "2020-05-14"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1606470875:3"
work_title: "Rebranding the identity of a leading swiss construction and real estate company. "
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">LIKA AL GmbH is an ecosystem of architects, businessmen and engineers pioneering a new era in construction and real estate development in Switzerland. Their network of partners in the region makes them a driving force for a complete package in the real estate industry. Their staggering growth since they were formed in 2012 has been second to none in the region. As they continue to grow rapidly, TROKIT collaborated with the organisation to develop a new identity that would fit their development as a big company. </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKITS objectives were to provide clarity in their company profile, their services and highlight their organisational structure, whilst keeping the heart of their brand in mind and not losing touch with those who founded the organisation. With over 13 years of experience of rejuvenating brands and delivering fresh identities for companies, TROKIT were well equipped. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Designers at TROKIT utilised a part of the roof element in their previous logo and used it as an advantage to describe the growth acceleration and rapid advancement in LIKA’s journey. Keeping the colours and knowing that simplicity is key, TROKIT’s end product for the client was a success. </span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

## Mi beratung

---
title: "MI Beratung"
date: "2024-08-02"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_lock: "1722610718:3"
_edit_last: "3"
onesignal_meta_box_present: "1"

work_title: "Honoring Heritage, Embracing Future - this is the rebranding story of MI Beratung"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: "Honoring Heritage, Embracing Future - this is the rebranding story of MI Beratung"
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "In the dynamic world of insurance consulting, staying relevant and resonant with clients is essential. MI Beratung, a prominent insurance consulting company in Switzerland, has undertaken a strategic rebranding to reflect its rich heritage, comprehensive services, and forward-thinking ethos. Founded in 2004 by Muminovic Ismet, MI Beratung has grown to serve over 25,000 clients with a team of 25 dedicated professionals. This rebranding marks a significant milestone in its journey, blending its founder's legacy with modern visual and conceptual elements.

MI Beratung, derived from the initials of its founder Muminovic Ismet, coupled with the German word \"Beratung\" meaning consulting, has built a reputation for its wide-ranging services. Specializing in personal and property insurance, private provision, company pension funds, mortgages, and tax advice, the company has established itself as a one-stop solution for both private individuals and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

Central to MI Beratung’s rebranding is the introduction of a new logo, deeply rooted in the founder's Bosnian heritage. The previous symbol featured three vertically is now replaced by a larger triangle (composed of these three triangles), and symbolizes the map of Bosnia and Herzegovina. These three triangles simultaneously represent the country’s ethnic diversity – Bosnians, Serbs, and Croats. This design not only honors Muminovic Ismet’s origins but also underscores a message of unity and inclusivity."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "The rebranding extends to a distinctive typographic style, where each letter of \"MI Beratung\" incorporates elements from the new logo. This unique design choice ensures that the brand’s visual identity is cohesive and immediately recognizable, reinforcing the connection between the company’s name and its symbolic representation.

The rebranding is not just about visual elements; it signifies MI Beratung’s commitment to delivering an enhanced customer experience. The goal of the rebranding process was to emphasize simplicity and accessibility, ensuring clients can navigate their insurance and financial needs with ease.

By honoring its founder’s legacy and embracing modern design and service principles, MI Beratung is poised to continue its growth and success. The new brand identity reflects the company's commitment to heritage, unity, and innovation, ensuring it remains a trusted partner for all insurance and financial consulting needs.

In conclusion, with a refreshed visual identity and a continued commitment to comprehensive, high-quality service, MI Beratung is ready to meet the evolving needs of its clients and the challenges of the future."

## Miamind

---
title: "Miamind - Bottneuro"
date: "2024-01-25"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_lock: "1706181205:4"
_edit_last: "4"

work_title: "Brand system identity for Miamind, Swiss Pioneering Neuro Solutions Company"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "In the nowadays dynamic landscape of healthcare technology, the intersection of innovation and compassion has given rise to groundbreaking solutions that redefine the way we approach neurological disorders. Among these pioneering advancements is Miamind by Bottneuro, a revolutionary personalized diagnostic and therapy device for brain health.

Miamind stands at the forefront of personalized brain health solutions, offering a diagnostic and therapy device that has received approval in Switzerland. This cutting-edge technology will provide clinics with a transformative tool for treating a spectrum of conditions, including Alzheimer's disease, depression, stroke, and epilepsy. Its innovative approach combines diagnostic precision with targeted therapeutic interventions, ushering in a new era of patient-centric neurological care."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "The brand name, Miamind, seamlessly fuses the concepts of 'Mia' and 'Mind,' (MyMind) evoking a sense of individuality, warmth, vitality, and the vibrancy of the brain. This unique combination not only reflects the product's focus on cognitive well-being but also hints at the innovative spirit driving its development. The 'MM' in Miamind symbolizes initials, frequency of the brain activity, and represents the very device itself.

The choice of purple as the primary color for Miamind's visual identity is deliberate and profound. Purple, often associated with creativity, wisdom, and sophistication, takes on added significance as it is the color linked to Alzheimer's disease awareness. This intentional color selection communicates the brand's commitment to addressing neurological challenges while fostering empathy and understanding.

Miamind's typography is sleek, sans-serif font that conveys a sense of precision and sophistication, aligning with the brand's position as a leader in the field of personalized brain health solutions.

Inspired by the logo, Miamind's visual pattern comprises fluid lines that reflect the intricate and dynamic nature of brain frequency activity. This design choice not only adds a visually engaging element to the brand but also symbolizes the adaptability and responsiveness of Miamind's diagnostic and therapeutic capabilities.

Miamind by Bottneuro emerges as a trailblazer in the realm of personalized brain health solutions. Its innovative approach, coupled with a thoughtful brand development strategy, positions it as more than just a medical device; it becomes a symbol of hope, progress, and compassion in the journey towards understanding and treating neurological conditions. As Miamind continues to make strides in the global healthcare landscape, its brand narrative reflects a commitment to advancing the future of neurological care."

_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "<p style=\"font-weight: 400;\">In the bustling world of frozen foods, where convenience often overshadows quality, there emerges a brand that defies the norm. Meet Minus Zero Foods, the brainchild of Eurofruti, a renowned company with over three decades of expertise in the cultivation, processing, and export of fruits and mushrooms. Rooted in Kosovo's rich agricultural landscape, Minus Zero Foods brings a new dimension to frozen produce, matching freshness, sustainability, and community support in every bite.</p>
<p style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Eurofruti's legacy spans generations, earning its stripes as one of Kosovo's leading companies. With a robust infrastructure and a commitment to excellence, Eurofruti has mastered the art of sourcing, processing, and exporting an array of fruits and mushrooms. Their prowess extends to the collection of over 2000 tons of mountainous fruits, including blueberries, blackberries, raspberries, strawberries, cherries, plums, and approximately 100 tons of mushrooms annually. It's this rich heritage and unparalleled expertise that form the backbone of Minus Zero Foods.</p>
<p style=\"font-weight: 400;\">At the core of Minus Zero Foods lies a philosophy that blends innovation with nature's bounty. Drawing inspiration from the brand's name and ethos, the logo embodies the essence of freshness and purity. The symbol of a minus sign, juxtaposed with the numeral zero, evokes a sense of crispness and clarity. The frozen fruit, depicted with icy crystals, symbolizes the brand's commitment to preserving nature's goodness. A delicate green leaf adorning the symbol signifies the freshness and vitality of Minus Zero Foods' offerings.</p>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<p style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Eurofruti's legacy spans generations, earning its stripes as one of Kosovo's leading companies. With a robust infrastructure and a commitment to excellence, Eurofruti has mastered the art of sourcing, processing, and exporting an array of fruits and mushrooms. Their prowess extends to the collection of over 2000 tons of mountainous fruits, including blueberries, blackberries, raspberries, strawberries, cherries, plums, and approximately 100 tons of mushrooms annually. It's this rich heritage and unparalleled expertise that form the backbone of Minus Zero Foods.</p>
<p style=\"font-weight: 400;\">At the core of Minus Zero Foods lies a philosophy that blends innovation with nature's bounty. Drawing inspiration from the brand's name and ethos, the logo embodies the essence of freshness and purity. The symbol of a minus sign, juxtaposed with the numeral zero, evokes a sense of crispness and clarity. The frozen fruit, depicted with icy crystals, symbolizes the brand's commitment to preserving nature's goodness. A delicate green leaf adorning the symbol signifies the freshness and vitality of Minus Zero Foods' offerings.</p>
The typography, a fusion of modern sans-serif and traditional serif elements, reflects the brand's ethos of blending innovation with tradition. It strikes a balance between sophistication and approachability, inviting consumers to embark on a journey of long list of fruit/vegetable exploration.

Every package of Minus Zero Foods is a canvas of vibrant hues, mirroring the diversity and richness of the fruits and vegetables within. From the deep purples of blueberries to the fiery reds of strawberries, each color palette is meticulously chosen to evoke the essence of the produce it contains. The illustrations adorning the packages are a testament to the brand's commitment to authenticity and transparency, representing the landscapes where the fruits and vegetables are cultivated.

The rich legacy of expertise, a commitment to freshness and sustainability, and a visual identity that captivates the senses make Minus Zero Foods a key player in the frozen food landscape. As consumers explore the world of frozen delights, Minus Zero Foods extends an invitation to savor the goodness of nature, one frozen treat at a time."

## Mirage energydrink

---
title: "Mirage Energy Drink"
date: "2020-04-28"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1631175377:3"
work_title: "Brand identity development for the French retail market"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Mirage is a French brand energy drink. In a short period, this energy drink is dominating the French market. It is the third most consumed energy drink in “Hexagon”.</span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKIT designed the brand identity, packaging and launched the main marketing campaign.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Bearing in mind that Mirage is solely designated as a French brand, this determined the direction in which the brand identity of this product was designed. The name of the brand was borrowed from the famous fighter jet MIRAGE, also TROKIT extracted some elements of the MIRAGE and incorporated it into the visual identity. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The visual identity and typography contain contemporary elements, knowing that this drink has the possibility to please two target audiences, men and women in the French retail industry. Based on this, TROKIT inspired the brand to develop two flavours for these two target audiences. With two target audiences in mind, TROKIT had then utilised the colours of the French national flag to develop the variant drinks. The left ribbon of the French national flag inspired the colour for the men’s variant in the can, whereas the right ribbon inspired the women’s flavour which is different even in colour and the taste of the liquid inside. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The colour black is chosen for Mirage canned drinks. Against this background, blue and rose logos are embossed in a black tin can which makes this product look sophisticated to our current and new customers.</span>"

## Morphinity

---
title: Morphinity
date: "2024-02-22"

_edit_lock: "1708702466:4"

work_title: "The Branding and Web Development for Morphinity, an ambitious Swiss 3D printing and engineering company"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "Morphinity is a 3D printing company poised to revolutionize the industry. With a mantra of taking 3D printing to the next level, Morphinity seamlessly blends cutting-edge technology, value engineering, and automation to transform ideas into tangible reality.

At Morphinity, they are more than just a 3D printing service provider. Their commitment lies in not just meeting but exceeding the expectations of their clients, and pushing the boundaries of what is possible with 3D printing.

Their services span from top-notch 3D printing, where dreams come to life in the form of intricate designs, to value engineering, where products are optimized for success, and automation using their remarkable modular printers. Each aspect of their operation is precisely crafted to deliver unparalleled results, setting new standards within the industry.



"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "Inspired by the transformative journey of the butterfly, the creation of this brand draws parallels between the process of metamorphosis and the evolution of ideas into reality. The symbol of infinity, representing endless possibilities, is duplicated to form the letter M, the initial of Morphinity, encapsulating the essence of perpetual innovation. To harmonize with the symbol, a typography with round fonts was chosen, to add charm and friendliness to this brand.

Just as the butterfly undergoes a beautiful and challenging metamorphosis, Morphinity embraces the complexity of 3D printing with passion and dedication. Their commitment to excellence is mirrored in every project they undertake, turning challenges into opportunities and obstacles into achievements.

Drawing inspiration from the mesmerizing Blue Morph butterfly, the color palette encompasses the nuances of blue and violet, symbolizing elegance, creativity, and transformation. The blending gradients of these colors capture the dynamic and ever-evolving nature of the 3D printing industry, where innovation knows no bounds.

With meticulous attention to detail, Trokit developed a vibrant visual identity and iconography that perfectly encapsulates the essence of Morphinity.

From the sleek logo design to the dynamic webpage, every element reflects the innovation, precision, and creativity that define Morphinity. Through Trokit's expertise, Morphinity now has a digital presence that not only showcases its capabilities but also invites others to join in its extraordinary journey of exploration and discovery.

This branding elevates Morphinity to the forefront of the 3D printing revolution and instills in this emerging company a heightened confidence to persist in pushing the boundaries of what is achievable, thereby transforming dreams into reality.

"

## Multinet

---
title: "Multinet Communication"
date: "2020-04-08"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1631174616:3"
_thumbnail_id: "420"
work_title: "Rebranding a swiss telecommunications and engineering company"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "Since their founding in 2008, Multinet has entirely put their commitment into telecommunications network construction in Switzerland. Their defining goal is to actively participate in the construction of the Swiss telecommunications network of the future and to lay the foundation for data communication for today and tomorrow."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<p dir=\"ltr\">They are characterized above all combined offerings in the areas of civil engineering, technology and planning from their own company and the high degree of specialization in FTTx networks.</p>
<p dir=\"ltr\">For a business to begin striving into the digital age, there must be a reflective period in which they look at their resources and build on what works and what doesn't. For Multinet it wasn't their service, because their internal business structure and operations were successful. However, the touchpoint was tangled, which is their visual identity. Therefore, Trokit saw a great opportunity to develop a new identity that could take Multinet into that very digital age.</p>
<p dir=\"ltr\">Transforming what was a complicated, non-cohesive brand identity and developing a minimalist variant was a brave choice by the team at Trokit. What was apparent from the previous identity was the many elements in the logo that was not in sync accordingly, a mixture of 3D and 2D design with different font size variants wasn't adequate for the digitized future.</p>
<p dir=\"ltr\">These elements were simplified and modernised. The cable in the previous identity was now used to create a concept of buildings and the typography designed accordingly. Unique and specific to Multinet and their company only, it is a distinctive feature that makes the fresh identity stand out.</p>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

## Nordik clinic

---
title: "Nordik Clinic"
date: "2024-03-22"
author: "trokit-editor"
_edit_lock: "1711544614:3"
_edit_last: "4"
onesignal_meta_box_present: "1"
onesignal_send_notification: 
onesignal_modify_title_and_content: 
onesignal_notification_custom_heading: 
onesignal_notification_custom_content: 
work_title: "Brand system identity for Nordik Clinic, a new Swedish medical experience in the Balkans"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "The Aurora Borealis or Northern Lights is a fascinating display of light in the night sky, occurring at the North Pole. Occasionally, the space weather interacting with Earth allows the auroras to extend even farther from the poles, ranging from 60 to 600 miles in altitude. These multicolored lights constantly change in shape and intensity, from faint and scattered to intensely bright.

Medicine is a field that undergoes daily changes, similar to the auroras that never appear in the same form. They are connected to solar activity, just as we humans cannot live without its energy. This is where our inspiration comes from.

"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "Developing a brand is the visualization of a name. The Trokit team, as in this case, remains loyal to this concept. Therefore, finding it is very close to the name - Nordik. Instead of using traditional elements that have already become a typical visual language for health, clinics... like a snake, a rod, a cross... our proposal goes far beyond these. It is based on a small abstract \"n\" inspired by the shapeless form of the aurora and its dominant green hues.

Creating a vibrant brand is the pursuit of every digital artist. This is because in the multitude of endless brands, today it remains a great challenge to 'stand out'. Fluidity, vitality, modernity, facing the times, and not necessarily indicating that it is a health object have been our guidelines for this brand. We believe that these have been achieved at Nordik Clinic."
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">PATOS, the renowned brand of tortilla chips, was interested in developing potato chips. PATOS entrusted this mission to the TROKIT. BPC, which is a profound partner in the development of brands in the region, introduced TROKIT to PATOS.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Initially, the Trokit team was devoted to the most subtle stage, to create a concept, distinctive from other products on the market. From here the name PATOS, ‘PATATOS’ emerged, a proposal that was welcomed by PATOS management. This approval gave TROKIT an even greater zeal to move to the next stages. Design of the logo, typography, colour definition, packaging, all in all, a total package with the elements colliding to make a unique product in the market. Flavours ranging from classic salt to oregano, TROKIT wanted to display the impactful ingredients that make ‘PATATOS’ so delicious. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Vibrant, energetic and eye-catching were a few of the words to describe the packaging. TROKIT had captured the essence of the seasoning into a visual and tangible product. </span>

_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb

_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "The rising demand for high-quality tuning equipment and accessories, mainly after the sequels of the Fast and Furious movies, has become a massive trend for many young Swiss. Among the leading companies in this sector is Peparts.

The rapid increase in demand for Peparts services and accessories made this company consider rebranding. This was the right moment to redefine Peparts' identity as one of Switzerland's key players in the tuning car industry.

Trokit carefully considered the elements of the existing brand. The team also listened carefully to every single detail of the new direction that its owner, Petrit, wanted to give the company in the next decade.

&nbsp;"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "The symbol was redrawn by the design team to make it suitable on offline and online platforms. Designers \"gave wings\" to the initials PE. In the symbol, there are traces of two crossed racing flags. To further define the adrenaline and speed that these modified cars provide, the letter E was flipped. The red color does not differ from the previous brand except that it is more lighted up. The unique, careful serif typography represents durability and finesse, both of which are at the core of the brand.

All the elements of the new brand have been developed in such a way as to produce a brand system identity that brings out the unforced yet emblematic Peparts. The new visual identity represents an important step for this company, turning it into a reference in the ever-growing trend of car modifications."

work_title: "Re-branding and re-designing paper brand Petal."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">To gain its sustainable position in the market, PETAL needed something which differentiated itself from its competitors. For this reason, the brand required a complete transformation. This urge led us to create a unique identity based on its name.  </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">We decided to keep the current colours, but with a slight change and that is the bright nuance of magenta. The secondary colours like blue, green and purple will be used accordingly to the various products.</span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Typography has more character than the previous one. Even the empty spaces of the typography are designed with the petal shapes. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The added value of this identity is the character of the brand. The hummingbird replaced the unnoticed butterfly. A hummingbird, nimble and cute creation has an important role in the reproduction of the flowers, because during the day ‘visits’ around 1500 flowers. A perfect harmony of nature with the brand. When connecting this with the aromas and the quality of the products, then it automatically displays that PETAL is a component of nature, in turn proposing the brand's new slogan “Part of nature. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">With modifications to the typography and brand identity, it was in TROKITS nature to standardise the table of information and the icons within, in order to establish coherence with the new brand. </span>"

## Reload

---
title: Reload
date: "2020-03-29"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1598384443:3"
work_title: "Full rebranding and concept development for the TV & Entertainment industry."
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Energy and unscripted content are what makes RELOAD a popular and exciting new TV program in the region. To start developing a new identity for RELOAD, the team at TROKIT had to step into a state of mind that allowed them to create something bold, fun and eye-catching. </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">It was brought on by the team to capture what makes a program like RELOAD so unique in the industry. Spontaneity was a contributing factor and in result, this resembled through the array of colours selected by the designers, the concepts likewise, fitted the favoured colours. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The initial concept colour ‘red’ is displayed to connect with the point at which a camera begins to record, binding the act of capturing the events that happen during the program. Green is used to symbolise a charging battery which can also be linked to the burst of energy. Orange represents the sun’s optimism, activity, in succession the sun rises and sets every day linking the name of the brand. The final concept identified was a play button with this came an idea to include a colour spectrum rather than a solid colour. The spectrum connected to the spontaneous nature of the program in that anything can happen at any time. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">With the colours set in stone, it was the designer's creativity that led to experimenting with a range of shapes that collage together on various final prints and digital.</span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1

## Sach pizza

---
title: "Sach Pizza"
date: "2020-04-28"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1598385038:3"
work_title: "Rebranding a fastest growing pizza chain in Kosovo"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Initial meetings with the owners of SachPizza revealed an ambitious plan: opening 10 units in the next 5 years. Consequently, the idea has emerged for a new look, something that would reflect the feeling of restaurant guests and the expansion of the company.</span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKIT held the foundation of the identity, main symbol - saç (a spherical baking metal lid used in our traditional cuisine), however, the team modernized it in order to appeal to a wider target. Orange/red and green remained primary colours, with black and white as secondary colours. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Upon entering the restaurant, guests will immediately notice a modern, streamlined menu board, by far one of the best marketing tools for a restaurant is the menu design. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The biggest change that guests faced was pizza boxes. New boxes represented in the best manner our work and messages: brick oven pizza and just in time delivery. Pizza boxes are essentially the packaging of the product (or food in this regard). Therefore, it had to be recognisable for the audiences and translate their new brand.</span>"

## Siesta

---
title: Siesta
date: "2020-04-27"
author: "Troki Master"
_edit_last: "3"
_edit_lock: "1595941304:3"
work_title: "Naming and brand identity for furniture and sleep industry in Kosovo. "
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_description: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Siesta Comfort was founded in April 2015 with a small staff, but with high ambitions and mission to offer customers something that they need most - Comfort. After years of experience in the furniture industry, inherited from their father, the desire to bring something new drove them to provide better sleep and comfort for people in their bedrooms. So they started to invest in the mattress sector. </span>"
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">‘Siesta’ name derives from the tradition of a midday nap, common in Spanish speaking nations. The act of taking a nap is considered an essential effort of avoiding the midday heat and thus allowing workers to work later into the night. Naming the brand Siesta provided a strong blueprint for the creatives at TROKIT to build on. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">Designing the decorous typography that expressed the name was important. The soft and rounded edges of the letters indicating the comfort and relaxation of sleep. Deep blue was chosen for the typography as it subconsciously indicates deep dream-like sleep to the target consumer. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The elements of the visual identity started to awake, the dot of the letter ‘i’ now represented the sun's position during the common hours of Siesta. Along with this, the dot of the ‘i’ can also resemble a person's head tilting forward as if they required sleep. The colour orange met this portrayal as it also connected the heat of the sun during the mid-afternoon. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">The minimalist marble-like patterns that sit in the background of an array of promotional prints, digital formats and even some of their products compliments the brand in a significant way. The texture melts as if it were itself, dozing off to sleep. </span>

<span style=\"font-weight: 400;\">TROKit provided Siesta Comfort with an extensive package that would lay the foundation for what was a high-end product for the region. Today, it is one of the leading companies, operating throughout the territory of Kosovo with retail and wholesale of mattresses combined with all the other products that are related in a way or another with sleep.</span>"
_work_description_full: field_5e7cb805772d1
client_location: Kosovo

title: Wyvern

work_title: "Branding and illustration for French streetwear company"
_work_title: field_5e7b34c4212fb
work_link: 
_work_link: field_5f17df779d311
work_description: "Creating a streetwear brand isn’t an easy task at all. First, creating a fashion brand for the French market is a big challenge, regardless of the branch. Second, wearing a logo communicates your identity and the clan to which you belong because Gen Z appreciates brands that share their ideals. Almost all streetwear brands are considered \"in\", thus wearing their clothing implies that you have your finger on the pulse. Third, streetwear brands are also being creative with their spaces and using the power of digital to drive their audience to locations. Fourth, the task was not just to design a prominent brand identity, but also a fable with illustration, and strategy for this promising streetwear brand."
_work_description: field_5e7cb7920abad
work_description_full: "We encounter the wyvern as a mascot of schools and sports teams, as well as in mythology and folklore, and it plays a significant part in heraldry. But nowadays, this creature is frequently depicted in fiction, video games, street art, and movies. Therefore, we needed the Wyvern brand to have a strong visual identity and be able to compete in this saturated market. The aim was to create a brand that is strong, youthful, vibrant and has character. The concept behind this was to create a brand that is unique, easy to read and memorable. Integrating the symbol within the typeface is often hard work, but not impossible. We’re lucky to use the letter Y and transform it into a look-like wyvern and at the same time using this symbol separately.
<div></div>
<div></div>"
